title: at/on/in (time)
subtitle: Предлоги времени: at для часов, on для дней, in для месяцев и лет

head: Предлог
Когда
Примеры
rows: at 7 o'clock, at noon, at night, at the weekend, at Easter, at the moment
on Monday, on 5 June, on my birthday, on New Year's Day, on Friday evening
части дня, месяцы, сезоны, годы, века
in the morning, in May, in winter, in 2019, in the 1990s

items: in the morning, но on Monday morning — если указан конкретный день, нужен on.
at Christmas (рождественские праздники), но on Christmas Day (сам день 25 декабря).
at the weekend — британский вариант, on the weekend — американский.

theory.text: Перед last, next, this, every предлог не нужен: last summer, next Friday, this evening, every morning.
in + период = «через» (столько-то времени от настоящего момента): The bus leaves in ten minutes. I'll be back in a week.
«Через неделю» — это in a week, а не after a week. А «в следующую пятницу» — просто next Friday, без on и in.

en: The lesson starts at nine o'clock.
The lesson begins at nine o'clock.
The lesson starts at nine.

items.ru: Я обычно обедаю в час дня.
en: I usually have lunch at one o'clock.
I usually have lunch at one.
I don't sleep well at night.
What are you doing at the weekend?
What are you doing on the weekend?
What are you doing this weekend?
We visit our parents at Christmas.
She's busy at the moment.
At the moment she's busy.

items.ru: У меня день рождения в пятницу.
en: My birthday is on Friday.
We'll meet on Monday morning.
We're meeting on Monday morning.
He was born on 3 May.
He was born on May 3.
He was born on the third of May.
He was born on 3rd May.

items.ru: Что вы делаете в субботу вечером?
en: What are you doing on Saturday evening?
What are you doing on Saturday night?
The shops are closed on Christmas Day.
The shops are shut on Christmas Day.
The shops are closed on 25 December.
I was born in 1995.

items.ru: В апреле в Лондоне часто идёт дождь.
en: It often rains in London in April.
In April it often rains in London.
We go to Italy in summer.
We go to Italy in the summer.
In summer we go to Italy.
I work better in the morning.
I work better in the mornings.
We usually go for a walk in the evening.
We usually go for a walk in the evenings.
We usually go for walks in the evening.
My parents met in the 1980s.
My parents met in the eighties.
My parents met in the 80s.
See you next Friday.
I'll see you next Friday.

items.ru: Прошлым летом мы ездили в Испанию.
en: We went to Spain last summer.
Last summer we went to Spain.
I drink coffee every morning.

en: I'll call you this Saturday.

The train is leaving in ten minutes.
I'll be back in a couple of days.

Will they come back in a week?
